title: Arrow of Fire

sources.title: Arrow of Fire
markers: * Deals {{InfoBlob|Weapon Damage}} and explodes in a blast of fire, dealing an additional {{DamageText|2d4|Fire|drs=t}} damage.

summary: Weapon damage plus 2d4 Fire. DC 12 Dexterity negates the extra Fire damage. Creates a 7 ft-radius Fire surface for 2 turns. The surface deals 1d4 Fire per turn and can apply Burning. The shared arrow rules describe damage as applying to the target rather than nearby creatures.

fields.Activation: Action. Fire from a ranged weapon and consume one arrow. Range 60 ft.
fields.Effect: Weapon damage plus 2d4 Fire. DC 12 Dexterity negates the extra Fire damage. Creates a 7 ft-radius Fire surface for 2 turns. The surface deals 1d4 Fire per turn and can apply Burning. The shared arrow rules describe damage as applying to the target rather than nearby creatures.
fields.Restrictions: Special arrows cannot be used with off-hand ranged attacks.
fields.Crafting: Special arrows are obtained from loot or vendors.
fields.Creative use: Use the fire to make an approach less attractive.
fields.Base value: 10 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Burning: The Fire surface can apply Burning for 1 turn. Burning deals 1d4 Fire per turn.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 activation, effects and linked rules.
